questions.stem: Convert the decimal number 45 to binary. Provide your answer as a binary number.
questions.explanation: To convert 45 to binary, divide by 2 repeatedly and record the remainders: 45/2 = 22 R1, 22/2 = 11 R0, 11/2 = 5 R1, 5/2 = 2 R1, 2/2 = 1 R0, 1/2 = 0 R1. Reading the remainders backwards gives 101101.

questions.stem: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using binary versus hexadecimal for data representation in computer systems.
markingGuide: Binary is the native language of computers.
Binary is more difficult to read and write for humans.
Hexadecimal is more compact and easier to read.
